release_read.basis: Revenue $3.66bn vs $3.55bn street, adjusted operating income $379m vs a $200-260m guide (10% margin a quarter early), backlog $132.5bn (+$28bn q/q) and FY26 revenue raised to $13.0-13.3bn above the ~$12.86bn street: delivery fears from the Nov-2025 and May-2026 prints look answered. Offsets: Q3 capex $14.5bn and net loss $709m keep the financing worry alive, so well inside the 16% implied move.

release.headline: CoreWeave Q3 2026: revenue $3.66bn (+168%), backlog $132.5bn, FY26 revenue guide raised to $13.0-13.3bn
release.release_note: Company's own press release not fetched in time (IR news page renders by script); figures from wire/press coverage of the release, labelled snippet_only. Release time approximate (after the close, call 17:00 ET per company date notice https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Announces-Date-of-Third-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-and-Conference-Call/).

vs_bar.note: actual EPS not established in time; net loss reported $709m (snippet_only); Benzinga calls it a double beat

key_line.detail: Backlog $132.5bn, +$28bn q/q from $104.2bn; adjusted operating margin 10% a quarter ahead of plan. Capex $14.5bn in the quarter.

call.detail: Call held last night; coverage headlines revenue +168% and guidance raised; an analyst piece says one could 'almost hear the sigh of relief'. After-hours went from ~+8% to ~+1.8% during coverage, then back to +7.9% last AH print, i.e. the call did not hurt.

public_reaction.summary: Wire coverage reads 'breakout quarter', 'double beat, raises guidance', 'sigh of relief'; one piece flags capex of $14.5bn sparking a 'sharp after-hours divide'. No price-target changes found in the time available.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 55.17 = +13.2% vs prev close 48.73 (position +15.1% from entry 47.85), double my frozen +6.5% release read and close to the 16% implied move; after-hours was +7.9%, so the pre-market added ~5 points overnight with QQQ +1.9%. Pre-market high 57.26 already sagged to ~55. Lively tape: 236 prints, 31 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:15, not stale.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was that landlord deliveries (Core Scientific +90 MW, Applied Digital RFS) meant capacity landed; the AOI beat, backlog jump and raised guide confirm it. Capex/financing risk named by the judges is still there.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market with prints to 09:15, so the open should hold the +13%. The gap is large, beyond what the release alone supports, has already slipped from the 57.26 high, and is helped by a strong Nasdaq pre-market; amc gaps of this size tend to give part back by 10:00.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de stelling (omzet en winst boven verwachting, orderboek fors hoger, jaarverwachting omhoog), maar de koers staat voorbeurs al ruim 13% hoger, ongeveer twee keer wat de cijfers zelf rechtvaardigen. De voorbeurshandel is levendig, dus de opening houdt die winst waarschijnlijk vast; daarna is teruglopen waarschijnlijker dan verder stijgen. Verkoop op de opening, zoals de standaardregel voor amc.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 terugzakt onder ongeveer 53,7 (de voorbeurs-low) of juist met veel prints boven 57 doorbreekt, de keuze opnieuw bekijken; anders blijft het verkopen op de opening.
